text:
jordan: quick review we're iterating on alerting panel density and suppression affordances. Figma: https://figma.com/file/alert-panel. main ask: make the top hero compact without hiding threshold help or channel state. rina: can we reduce the header gap by 6px and tighten the subtitle line-height? keeps it readable but denser. owain: agree on spacing. also the suppression label is visual-only now. we should add visible text like '(suppressed)' for screen readers and color-blind users. sam: good call. color note: our amber 'warning' token is under 4.5:1 on white for 12px. I'll post swaps to hit AA. jordan: suppression UI idea: a subtle ghost pill with :zzz: icon + live hint 'Suppressed until 16:00 UTC' — hover shows exact end. keep main label short. rina: love short labels. mobile: collapse long labels to '1 active 2 sup.' and expand on tap to full text. owain: keyboard flow: pills need arrow nav, Home/End support, and Enter to toggle. propose role=\"listbox\" + option semantics and visible-hidden status text. snippet: ```
``` sam: also preview placement: inline next to channels feels more discoverable than bottom anchor. small preview button with tooltip 'Preview payload' opens modal. aria-bot: Accessibility check: preview modal must set role=\"dialog\" aria-modal=\"true\", trap focus, set initial focus to the dialog heading, and announce via aria-live polite. jaordan: (oops typo) jordan: noted aria-bot. copy tweak: threshold helper now says 'Percentage failing (5m window)'. shorter than previous. rina: micro-ux: token chips baseline misaligned with inputs. bump min-height to 28px and align text baseline. owain: also add 6px left gap between label and numeric stepper on narrow sizes (<=480px) to avoid crowding. sam: action items: rina updates figma spacing and mobile collapsed labels, owain will prototype keyboard semantics and sr text in the component lib, i'll do color passes to fix contrast, jordan will draft rollout notes and copy changes. target: figma + a11y PR by Thu. thanks :thumbsup:
